name: Strictest-applicable-minimum refusals (every applicable class applies)
description: Refusal cases for the class-selection contract: a step is verified against EVERY applicable class minimum — ingredient species classes, dish classes (casserole, stuffing) and reheating — and the strictest governs, with casseroles, stuffing and reheating overriding to 165 °F. Each refusal case passed the linter before the strictest-wins fix (species beat the dish and reheating missed its override); the final case pins the matching compliant true negative so the override never over-blocks a casserole that meets 165 °F.
